subject: Re: CypherPath security intake — CAIQ & SOC 2 Q&A
messages:
From: Alex Ortiz <alex.ortiz@cypherpath.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CypherPath security intake — CAIQ & SOC 2 Q&A

Hi Sergio / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing to kick off our SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2 intake next week and would like to schedule a 60-minute intake call to walk through the questionnaire and confirm evidence handoff.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Dec 2, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Dec 3, 09:00–10:00

Agenda (30–45 min walkthrough + 15–30 min artifact logistics):
- Quick introductions and scope (CAIQ vs SOC 2 overlap)
- Question triage (what we can answer vs need artifacts)
- Evidence handoff: SFTP/Drive, retention windows, sampling windows
- Recording consent + next steps and owners

I've attached our combined CAIQ/SOC 2 question set for context (cypherpath_caiaq_soc2_questions_20261130.pdf). Our security team (security@cypherpath.io) will be on the call.

Two asks up front:
1) Can Redwood confirm the expected sample window for telemetry/logs when you pull artifacts? (we typically expect a 30–60 day window but want to align)
2) Who will be our Redwood point-of-contact for encrypted log access and KMS questions?

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

Best,
Alex Ortiz
Head of Security Operations
CypherPath

Attachments: cypherpath_caiaq_soc2_questions_20261130.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ortiz <alex.ortiz@cypherpath.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CypherPath security intake — CAIQ & SOC 2 Q&A

Alex — thanks for the packet and the proposed slots. All good on our side to run a combined intake. We can take Wed Dec 2 at 10:00 PST.

Who will join from CypherPath? Please confirm names/emails for the logistics invite (we need an engineering/infra contact for KMS/log access and a compliance owner).

Quick answers to your upfront asks:
- Sample window: Redwood typically requests a 45-day telemetry window for signal/sample-based controls. If you can provide a 30–90 day window we can be flexible but aim for 45 days as the default. We'll call this out during the intake so the QNA owners know what to expect.
- POC for KMS/log access: Kimberly Park (cc'd) will be the technical owner for evidence collection and will coordinate any encrypted exports.

I'll attach our intake playbook (redwood-intake-playbook-202611.pdf) which outlines transfer methods, preferred file formats, and our evidence checklist so we can move fast on follow-ups.

Agenda update: add a short piece on recording and retention permissions (we ask for explicit consent if recordings will be shared beyond the immediate team).

We have a few internal asks before the call:
- Can CypherPath identify a primary contact for access to cloud logs (role + email)?
- Any known exceptions (data residency, air-gapped systems) we should be aware of?

If Wed 10:00 works, I'll send calendar invite and a short run-of-show.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-intake-playbook-202611.pdf
From: Alex Ortiz <alex.ortiz@cypherpath.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, security@cypherpath.io
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CypherPath security intake — CAIQ & SOC 2 Q&A

Sergio — Wed 10:00 PST works. Joining:
- Priya Shah <p.shah@cypherpath.io> (Compliance Manager)
- Marcus Lee <m.lee@cypherpath.io> (Infra lead, access and KMS)
- security@cypherpath.io (team inbox)

Two quick clarifications:
1) Telemetry window — Marcus confirms we can surface a 60-day window for the demo/export, and a 12-month aggregated retention baseline for controls testing.
2) Data residency — We have EMEA tenants for EU users, but the artifacts we're providing for this intake are US-only; no cross-border artifacts in this batch.

I've attached a short contacts CSV for the people joining (security-contacts-cypherpath-20261130.csv). We're fine with recording the intake provided the recording is used internally and shared to the engineering/compliance owners only. Please flag if Redwood needs a different consent.

Also one question for your intake playbook: in section 3 you mention "encrypted exports" — can you confirm whether Redwood's intake method requires a shared key exchange (we support PGP) or if we should expect a signed URL to an S3 staging bucket?

Thanks — see you on Wed.

Best,
Alex

Attachments: security-contacts-cypherpath-20261130.csv
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: CypherPath security intake — CAIQ & SOC 2 Q&A (planning notes)

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding the confirmed intake details and CypherPath attendees. Action items before Wed 10:00 PST: 

1) Kimberly: prepare the encrypted export options to propose on the call (PGP key exchange + S3 signed URL flow). Pull the internal KMS owner and have a short script ready describing how we rotate keys during evidence pulls.
2) Marissa: draft the intake run-of-show and attach the evidence checklist. Add a short slide on sampling expectations (we'll propose 45-day default, accept 30–90 days).
3) Sergio (me): create the calendar invite + HubSpot note (deal CP-2026-11) and upload combined packet to the drive link. Add the recording consent wording to the invite: "Recording will be used internally and shared with named engineering/compliance contacts only."

I'll also prepare a short pre-call note to CypherPath reiterating what artifacts we need in advance (schema for logs, access windows, and any audit reports).

Thanks team — let's keep this tight; goal is to get artifact handoff scheduled within 48 hours of the intake.

-Sergio
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
